# dsh-astryx-tonulls-en

English DSH bundle for the `astryx` skill.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins.git#tonulls&path:/dsh-[name]-tonulls/dsh-astryx-tonulls/packages/dsh-astryx-tonulls-en'
```

Automatic selection is off by default. Use `/dsh-astryx-tonulls on` to enable it and `/dsh-astryx-tonulls off` to turn it off. Direct invocation is also available with `/astryx`. See the [root README](../../README.md) for details.
